title: Step into Talayotic Menorca
description: Menorca has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2023 for its Talayotic culture, and Torre d'en Galmés is the largest prehistoric settlement in the Balearics: more than six hectares of talayots, round houses, a taula precinct and a water system cut into the rock. You walk it without queues and almost always in silence. If that leaves you wanting more, the Naveta des Tudons and Talatí de Dalt are half an hour away by car.
imageAlt: Taula precinct of the Torre d'en Galmés talayotic settlement, the largest in the Balearics, in Alaior (Menorca).
